The helper binds the frozen v1 contract, decodes trades/quotes/excluded through `read_series_tables` to exhaustion, keeps one prepared-batch set per raw instrument (1GiB / 65,536 / 50m bounds), and releases that storage in `finally`. Continuous swings go incomplete from the first F4, unknown action, or invalid-size non-snapshot address (physical source order, not a later minute gap). Clear `R` is counted and does not break flow. All five fixed swing scales run in one `DirectionalChangeStream`; every one-minute atom becomes a `CausalBar` and is checked against original `pivot_reference`. All five memory recipes run one-at-a-time on the full retained unit and the fixed root grid, with bounded 4096/256 scalar prefixes versus literal recurrences and the named zero-delay event-clock `build_memory` view. `passed` is set only after available required comparisons succeed. CPU stages close with a nonnegative orchestration residual.

Tests cover complete/same-time data, F4 between clean trades, invalid-size exclusion, clear-only vs gap, empty/quiet minutes, multi-instrument and source rejection, wrong clocks/contract/schema/row totals, structural unavailability, scalar timestamp-group unavailability, production-grid shape, fixture-local grids via the private helper, and closed CPU/cleanup. They use real Parquet/`BoundedOutputs` and original reference producers, not mocks of the candidate math.

**Unexecuted-check caveat:** this worker did not import, compile, scan, or run the new tests or any registered study check. A worker completion message is not verification evidence.
